tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Find current deals, coupons, sales and offers from real businesses worldwide, for any product or service. Use when a person asks for a deal, discount, coupon, promotion or the best price on something, optionally near a place. Every result is confirmed by the business and includes expiry date and ter

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Full details of one deal by id, including terms, coupon code, how to redeem and the business contact details.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Look up a business by name or id: where it is, how to contact it, what it says about itself, and every deal it currently has live. Use when a person asks about a specific business ("does X have any offers?", "tell me about X") or after search_deals to see everything else that business offers.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the category ids and deal types that can be used as filters in search_deals.
